## What changes

Describe the asset, feature, fix or documentation improvement and link its issue.
For assets, list exact CAB:path_id identities, intended biome scope and source files.

## Evidence and tracker changes

List completed stages and their evidence files. State what remains untested.
Do not mark an entire biome complete from a pilot or menu fixture.

## Validation

Record the commands and checks run. For visual changes, describe UV placement,
real alpha, compression, mips, lighting, distance and hardware scope as applicable.
Keep screenshots with original game content and raw game extracts local.

## Submission checklist

- [ ] I have the rights to submit these changes under the project's code or artwork license.
- [ ] Authored files have exact hashes, a public credit and license in provenance.
- [ ] No personal information, credentials, original game assets or installed mod files are included.
- [ ] Tracker changes use exact identities and reviewed evidence, with pending stages left unchecked.
- [ ] `python tools/refresh_tracker.py --check` and relevant tests pass.
